## Highlights
### New
- Site settings have a Screen Sharing choice, so you can block a site from asking to share your screen; macOS still asks what to share every time.
### Fixed
- Screen sharing on pages that run in Chromium uses the macOS sharing picker and needs no Screen Recording permission, and Crest no longer asks for that permission over and over.
---
Experimental builds are signed and notarized snapshots from the selected branch (chromium-control-plane). They may be less reliable than development or stable releases.
